products.description:
30-Day Chat Support

Thank you for purchasing 30-Day Chat Support. You now have 30 days of direct chat access to our implementation team to help you deploy and operate your Phoenixtekk solution.

What you get

  • Chat with our team over whatever messaging app you already use — SMS, WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Telegram, or the web.
  • Ask implementation questions, get unblocked, and validate your rollout.
  • Your 30-day window starts when your first session opens.

What happens next

After checkout we'll reach out within one business day to open your session and send your chat or scheduling link — over your preferred messaging app (SMS, WhatsApp, Teams, Slack, Telegram, or web). Your download below is your Getting Started guide.

One-time purchase. Questions? support@phoenixtekk.com
